description.value: Pho 99 is a Vietnamese restaurant in New Westminster offering an extensive menu of pho, banh mi, vermicelli bowls, and seafood noodles alongside a dedicated vegetarian section. The restaurant supports online ordering with customer pickup, and OSM confirms wheelchair-accessible entry and indoor seating. It is a reliable hot-meal stop for cyclists passing through the New Westminster corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website (pho99bc.com) is branded 'Pho 99 New Westminster' and lists a street address of 1190 8th Ave, New Westminster, BC — the OSM record has no address but its coordinates (49.2105, -122.934) fall within New Westminster, supporting a likely match despite the low-confidence URL discovery. The website confirms active operation via reviews as recent as February 2026 and lists an explicit vegetarian menu section; an online pickup ordering system corroborates takeout. No evidence for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or most other amenities was found on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: URL was discovered with low confidence due to multiple Pho 99 locations in the area; the website is explicitly branded 'Pho 99 New Westminster,' which aligns with the OSM coordinates but conflicts with the OSM community tag of 'Vancouver' — the community tag may be incorrect.
OSM name is 'Pho 99' but the website name is 'Pho 99 New Westminster'; no address in OSM to definitively confirm the website matches this specific record.
Phone number (+1 604-544-0746) and address (1190 8th Ave, New Westminster) are sourced from the website only; OSM lists neither.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active Vietnamese restaurant with recent customer reviews (February 2026), a full menu, and online ordering. Real and publicly accessible.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Dedicated 'Vegetarian Menu' section on website with items V1–V7 including vegetarian pho, salad rolls, banh mi, vermicelli bowls, and fried rolls
